import json, subprocess, sys, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
import pipeline

RUN = ['/app/submit/run']

def run(lines):
    data = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
    p = subprocess.run(RUN, input=data.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=120)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr[:2000])
    out = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    assert len(out) == len(lines), ('line count', len(out), len(lines))
    return [json.loads(l) for l in out]

sample_img = json.load(open('/app/examples/sample.image.json'))
mapped_img = json.load(open('/app/examples/mapped.image.json'))
sample_compile = json.load(open('/app/examples/sample.compile.json'))

res = run(bad_requests)
